Note that doses exceeding 3 grams do not provide additional benefits. 2. Administer 200 mg orally twice daily for 3-4 months (Cold-FX formulation). 3. American ginseng acts as an adaptogen, helping the body adapt to internal and external stressors, combat fatigue, and improve stamina. 4. It has been used for conditions such as anemia, enhancement of athletic performance, diabetes, digestive issues, gastritis, immune stimulation, impotence, infections, and stress. 5. American ginseng is possibly effective for managing diabetes and respiratory tract infections. However, there is insufficient reliable information to support its use for other conditions. 6.
